methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages fetched directly via WebFetch and verified on 2026-06-18 for Senja (senja.io/pricing), Testimonial.to (testimonial.to/pricing), Famewall (famewall.io/pricing), Boast (boast.io/pricing/), and Vocal Video (vocalvideo.com/pricing) — all prices extracted verbatim and confirmed. Trustmary's pricing page is JavaScript-rendered and returned no table; the only consistent figure across sources is the free Solo tier ($0). Paid Trustmary tiers were NULLED because independent sources conflict (smbguide.com and Capterra show Starter $19 / Business $59 / Scale $129, while a fresh June 2026 cross-source search returned $24 / $65 / $132) and the official page could not be read — null beats a guess. Shoutout's official page (shoutout.io/pricing/) returned blank; the only price figures came from a competitor comparison page (saywall.io) and alternativeto, so paid-tier prices were NULLED as unverified; the free tier is retained. Vouch's official page (vouch.pro/pricing) returned HTTP 500; its Free/$99/$600/custom tiers were corroborated against the live Capterra listing (capterra.com/p/267099/Vouch) and a fresh June 2026 search. Vocal Video's pricing page explicitly states ISO 27001 & 27701, GDPR, EU-UK-Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework, and HIPAA compliance — vendor HIPAA corrected to true. Compliance flags are only true where the vendor explicitly states them; else null. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
